purpose: six frozen records; candidates no-chirp-mean must pass; known failing old arms mechanism controls only
selection: unchanged minimum prior hash per original six training subjects
pri_basis: conditional interpretation of archived profile; p03 absent log explicitly flagged
synthetic: 400frames,ADC amplitude1000,4RX/128chirps/250ADC,range12,boresight8,continuous phase int16 quantized; independent TI-port reader matches production

gate.mean_time: configuration chirp-time centroid; no fitted lag; additionally report chirp0 and exact coherent-observation errors

precision: per condition complex64 and complex128 directDC sums; absolute error,reference norm,true relative error only above amplitude floor,and RMS error/theoretical coherent gain; no denominator floor disguised as relative error
layout: independent port from TI SWRA581B fig11/section9.2; verify raw word count, vendor-vs-production all frames, capture logs; p03 missing hardware log remains conditional

real.common_physical_doppler: DC only,shifted index4 for both FFTs; nonzero indices not interchangeable
real.range_rule: full_none DC mean absolute amplitude first256frames,mean over16beams,exclude raw range0/1,argmax; fixed contiguous8bins
real.target_rule: common full_none calibration top3 energy beam/range in fixed ROI,stable index tie break; weights normalized amplitudes; same targets/weights allarms
real.windows: N256,starts0:128:896; score starts>=256,>=80% finite reference; 36 windows per arm
real.phase_floor: window target RMS>1e-6 of full_none RMS scaled by chirpcount/64; all samples nonzero finite; below floor scores undefined, not zero; retain raw complex signals and reliability flags
real.postprocessing: P2 increments,cumsum float32,exact archived detrend_linear and zscore_1d,Hann power,fixed .5-2.75Hz argmax; singles and fixed fusion
real.labels: original exported reference,frame/20+0s,no extrapolation,no lag search; HR only scoring
real.metrics: MAE,centeredRMSE,centeredr,centeredstd ratio,pooledR2,reference-near power; paired record changes; no mean per-recordR2 claims
real.invalid_control: report abstentions; compare methods on same common valid windows for each pair,also report candidate coverage; do not require known-nullcontrol valid for candidate scoring

expansion: no automatic54record expansion: require both candidates valid and at least one candidate shows lower MAE AND centeredRMSE AND higher reference-near power vs legacy_mean in >=5/6 records with >=4 common fused windows/record,pooled centeredr>0 and pooled centeredRMSE below baseline; no statistical independence claim; no training
